title: Chapter 821
text:
After Han Xiao's fleet left Planet Pangurus, the players of the various guilds that were left behind on the planet could not wait to take action.

The four major guilds pretended to be uninvolved while they secretly gathered the members of the other first-rate guilds. Among them were the Rainstorm Club's Drizzle River, the Fanatics Club's God's Forbidden Zone, the Heavenly Palace's Spirit Celestial Lake, and Rivervale's Rivervale.

These first-rate guilds had around sixty to seventy members that were left behind on Planet Pangurus, and they were considered workshop players. There were two types of guild members. The first was the ordinary players that were attracted by the guild's reputation and resources. The second type was the various workshops that took on the hard work of the guild and collected a certain amount of fees. Hence, they were more organized.

Hundreds of guild members gathered together to discuss.

"The Russians and Australians don't have enough manpower, and each club has less than twenty people. Both sides have more than a hundred people."

"However, they did not split up, and over a hundred of them gathered together to mine."

Although the Russians and Australians had colluded with the four major guilds, they were secretly taking precautions. The Russians were led by the Strength and Glory Guild, while the Australians were led by the Kangaroo Boxing Guild. The players of the various guilds were gathered at two locations to mine. Adding up to a hundred people from each country, they were close to the number of first-rate guilds in China. This seemed to be safer and would prevent them from being attacked.

However, they did not expect that the first-rate guilds in China would work together to deal with them.

After discussing for a while, they decided on a plan. They had the absolute advantage in terms of manpower, and they decided to split up and attack the resource points of the Russians and Australians.

…

In a certain mine base, at the Kangaroo Boxing Guild's resource point …

Dozens of Australian players were wearing Worker Bee Armor and mining diligently. They stored the resources in the armor and transported them back to the small guild warehouse on the surface.

There were a few warehouses that belonged to different guilds in Australia. There were also workshop players patrolling the area. Although they worked together for safety, it did not mean that they would share the resources. These warehouses were portable warehouses that the various guilds had bought from the army, and they were not cheap. They were equivalent to their base in the resource point.

Suddenly, the patrolling players' expressions changed as they saw a group of well-equipped first-rate Guild players appear in their line of sight. These first-rate Guild players were currently charging towards them from afar, their thrusters leaving trails of flame in their wake.

"Gather! Someone is attacking our resource point! "

The Club guilds from Australia hastily recalled their manpower, but it was too late. Two to three hundred players from the first-rate guilds rushed into the resource point and tore apart the players guarding the warehouse.

The Australian players who had rushed back from the mines immediately engaged the players from the first-rate guilds.

A group battle erupted, and both sides immediately engaged in a chaotic battle!

Bang bang bang!

Pugilists used all kinds of strange abilities, filling the entire field with colorful energy. Mages kept casting spells one after another, Psychics crazily used psychic attacks to cause AOE damage, and they were all treated as backline slices. Metahumans used all kinds of strange abilities, filling the entire field with colorful energy. Mages kept chanting and casting spells one after another, while Psychics crazily used psychic attacks to cause AOE damage. They were treated as backline slices …

Among them, the Mechanic class caused the most damage. They used all kinds of weapons to attack. Blue energy beams crisscrossed, and when they hit the target, energy explosions would occur. Armor-piercing bullets shot out like torrents, splashing mud everywhere, breaking trees, and leaving fine pinholes on various objects.

Version 3.0 happened to be the powerful version where the Mechanic class shone. At this time, the Mechanic class finally learned the skill that allowed them to improve their combat style — compressed orb technology.

Compressed orbs opened up in the field one after another, turning into turrets, small mechanical soldiers, mechanical traps, and all kinds of mechanical equipment.

Be it in terms of wealth, combat power, or numbers, the first-rate guilds had an absolute advantage. They quickly destroyed the Australian players who had stayed behind and sent people to block the respawn point and kill them. On the other hand, they started to attack the few Australian guild warehouses and destroyed them very quickly. The resources that the Australian players had collected during this period were all taken away as spoils of war.

This resource point became a mess. After killing all the Australian players, the first-rate guilds immediately retreated with the spoils of war.

Hundreds of souls floating above the respawn point sent them off with grief and anger.

On the other hand, the Russian resource point also received the same treatment and was completely looted.

…

"Our resource point has been destroyed?"

In one of the transport ships in the fleet, Vodka was shocked when he received the message from the players who had stayed behind.

After hearing that it was done by the first-rate guilds in China, he was furious and immediately sent a message to the guild leaders of Long Sky and Dynasty to question them.

"Why did you attack our resource point?"

Jade Green Sky pretended to be confused. "What are you talking about? When did we do such a thing? You have to have evidence for everything. Otherwise, I'll sue you for slander. "

"Just now, the resource point we left on the planet was destroyed by your Chinese guild. The players who stayed behind were blocked at the resurrection point and killed until their resurrection count ran out. They couldn't resurrect in the game for six days. Why did those Chinese guild members attack us?

"You can ask them. We didn't do it." Jade Green Sky held back his laughter.

"We bought equipment from you guys, and you promised to provide us protection. You guys went back on your word!" Vodka said angrily.

Jade Green Sky snorted. It wasn't as if he didn't know about the little tricks of these foreign guilds. On the surface, they bought some equipment through their channels, but in private, they had already found other Chinese players to cooperate with and enjoy a 10% discount while keeping it a secret from them.

Morning Snow Twilight Frost chuckled. "We didn't know about this beforehand. After all, those first-rate guilds have their own thoughts and are not our subordinates. We have to ask them about the situation. Don't worry, we'll try our best to convince those guilds."

"That's great." Vodka nodded.

After hanging up, Vodka was unhappy. He only felt that something was amiss. No matter how he looked at it, these first-rate guilds working together to deal with them had something to do with the four biggest guilds. It might happen again in the future.

Thinking about that, he contacted the captain of the players who had stayed behind and said,

"After you guys revive, I'll transfer you a sum of money. Buy some warning devices in the army, such as automatic cannons, traps, laser arrays, and so on. Set them up next to the new resource point. The more you buy, the better. Don't be afraid of spending money … By the way, give up your current location and find a more dangerous place to mine."

On the other side, Jade Green Sky and Morning Snow Twilight Frost were also discussing.

"This attack can make them hesitate and spend more money on unnecessary defensive measures. Those first-rate guilds did not intend to attack frequently in the first place. We can say that we convinced those guilds and did not go back on our words. After these people build new resource points and recover for a while, we'll organize another attack. At that time, they'll have a new batch of resources in their resource points, and we'll be able to snatch them. If we continue to harass them like this, their resource points will be very limited. As long as we make them angry, we can start a large-scale guild war and use our advantage in numbers to wipe out the backbone of their guilds. "

"Insidious, you're the insidious one." Jade Green Sky gave him a thumbs up.

Morning Snow Twilight Frost shook his head. "It's a pity that they did not send their pro players over. Otherwise, our guilds could help the club get rid of some of their opponents."

Pro players were the pillars of the club, so the club placed great importance on their safety. Naturally, they would not dare to send their characters to other people's territory. The reason why the Chinese clubs targeted the foreign guilds was also to protect their own pro players. If the foreign guilds were allowed to gain a foothold in their territory, the possibility of them secretly causing trouble for the Chinese pro players was not low at all.

Others could cross Star Fields to come over, but they could not. The Chinese guilds were actually in a passive position, which was why they had decided to work together to compete with the foreign guilds and protect their own interests.

…

A few days later, in another Star Zone.

The Great Cosmos Corps fleet led by Kikiga was slowly moving toward the beacon. Other than the main ship that was dozens of kilometers long, there were more than thirty guard battleships. All the warriors who had been awakened were training. There were more than a million people.

Inside the main ship, Kikiga rubbed his palms with excitement. He loved plundering and looked forward to the arrival of war.

"How much longer until we reach the beacon?" Kikiga asked several times every day.

"Reporting to the leader, the beacon's position has been moving for the past few days. I think this is the enemy's trick to confuse us, so we are now moving towards the position where the beacon was first activated. It's not too far away." The leader of the operators had a helpless look on his face. He had to repeat his answer several times every day.

"The faster, the better. I can't wait." Kikiga's tone was rough.

At this time, another operator exclaimed.

"Big Leader, there are three unknown targets approaching us!"

"They can't be meteorites, right?" Kikiga was stunned.

In his impression, very few people could travel through space like them. Therefore, his first thought was that they were meteorites or comets.

"They don't look like meteorites. They're flying toward us! Sir, I request to enter alert mode! "

"Making a fuss over nothing," Kikiga mumbled and waved his hand. "Alert, then."

The fleet quickly activated all kinds of weapons and waited.

Not long later, the three spaceships that Psionic Prime and the others were on appeared and slowly stopped, facing Kikiga and the others.

"Are they really spaceships?" Kikiga was surprised.

"I guessed right," the operator hurriedly said. "They can track our beacon. Their technology is very advanced, and they can travel in the universe."

Kikiga sized up the three spaceships for a while and suddenly laughed.

"What are you afraid of? Look at those three spaceships. They're so small. How much combat power can they have? "

Indeed, the spaceships of Psionic Prime and the others were very small compared to Kikiga's main ship that was dozens of kilometers long.

In Kikiga's worldview, the size of a spaceship equaled its combat power.

"Also, look, they only have three spaceships, not even one-tenth of ours. We can easily kill them. What are you panicking for? You're embarrassing me." Kikiga shook his head.

Hearing this, everyone suddenly felt that it made sense and felt much more at ease.

"Sir, what should we do now?"

Kikiga said casually. "Looking at their spaceships, we can tell that they're just a small civilization that has just started exploring the universe. They don't know what fear is, so they dare to track our signal without any fear. Humph, as their seniors, we have to teach them a lesson and let them know the taste of fear."

At this moment, another operator smiled and said, "Big Leader, they sent us a message. They want to communicate with us."

Hearing this, everyone laughed and felt that Kikiga's guess was right. Only a civilization that had just started exploring the universe would be so naive. Did they think that they could communicate in the universe?

"What did they say?"

"Let me see … They said that they're from the Black Star Corps. They want us to put away our weapons and surrender immediately …" Before this person finished, he started laughing.

As if infected by his laughter, almost everyone in the control room could not help but laugh. The room was filled with a joyful atmosphere.

"Hahahaha …" Kikiga laughed so hard that he could not stop. "Quick, reply to my message."

"Reply to what?"

"Ask them if they've heard of the Great Cosmos Corps. Hahaha …" Kikiga laughed so hard that tears almost came out of his eyes.

Black Star Corps? What the hell? Never heard of it? Do they think they're very famous?

Don't they know that the Great Cosmos Corps is the overlord of this universe? They want us to surrender? He had never heard such a funny joke before.

Kikiga laughed so hard that he almost choked. He only calmed down after a while and said, "These arrogant natives are really the source of joy. They always make me happy …" Before he finished, he wanted to laugh again.

"Big Leader, are we going to attack?"

"Hmm, kill them … No, don't kill them. Capture them and give them to the Thearch. The Thearch will definitely be amused by these guys." Kikiga laughed.

Just as everyone was laughing non-stop, the operator captain suddenly felt his heart tremble. He realized a terrifying blind spot.

When they came into contact with the natives, they could not communicate at all because of the language barrier.

However, this is clearly the first time these natives have met us … so why do they know our language? Why can they communicate with us?

He trembled. Just as he was about to report this anomaly, something strange happened to the three spaceships.

The bellies of the three spaceships opened up and black machines poured out. All of a sudden, blue-gold lightning descended from the sky and struck every machine, causing a blinding light to erupt.

"What are these things?"

The smiles of Kikiga and the others disappeared. They looked at this scene in shock.

The next moment, a silver beam of light shot out, instantly piercing through the main ship's shield. It pierced through the main ship's hull, which was dozens of kilometers long, and left behind a large hole!

The 'tough' spaceship armor was like paper in front of this energy beam!

Everyone was stunned, and before they could react, the violent shaking knocked them to the ground.

A shrill alarm sounded, and the lights inside the spaceship turned bright red.

Wu wu wu!

"Warning, warning! Shield broken, hull damage increasing. 7.8% … 8.6% … 10.3% … Please take measures as soon as possible! Please take measures as soon as possible! "

With one hit, the defense of the main spaceship was broken!

Kikiga did not get up. He sat on the ground in a daze. His eyes were filled with confusion and disbelief.

What … just happened?
